pages.title: Water before fuel
pages.text: This is manual water and HEAT warm-up, not pressurized Steam. Form the vessel and its V2 firebox. Install the water inlet and all THREE chimney sections, leaving air above the stack. Right-click the actual WATER INLET with a water bucket to add 1,000 mB. Default capacity: 8,000 mB. An empty bucket drains water there. Water pipes cannot feed this first manual slice yet.

pages.title: Light the firebox
pages.text: Right-click the formed FIREBOX with one solid furnace fuel item. One item is consumed only when there is water, the complete chimney and a clear exhaust. Coal and existing Metallurgical Coke are supported; lava buckets and other container fuels are refused. Further clicks while burning do not queue or consume extra fuel. Smoke comes from the chimney only while real fuel burns.

pages.title: Read and stop
pages.text: Use an empty hand on the firebox, vessel or water inlet to read water, HEAT and fuel ticks. Sneak-use the FIREBOX with an empty hand to extinguish it; spent fuel is not refunded. HEAT is an abstract energy budget, NOT temperature or pressure. The default gain/loss values are provisional. At the buffer limit, an already-lit item still burns and surplus heat exits through the flue.

pages.title: Before dismantling
pages.text: Drain water through the inlet first. Dismantling a filled vessel spills its remaining water and dissipates its heat; neither is returned as a free bucket or fuel item. Save/reload retains active state with no offline catch-up. Steam conversion, pressure, automatic water intake, a working relief valve and engine power are still disabled.
